decision.reasoning_trace: I was primarily looking for a high-quality, new Bluetooth speaker, but the product feed was heavily cluttered with non-speaker items like replacement batteries, charging cables, and carrying cases. Within the actual speaker results, several of the top-rated items from reputable brands (like the JBL Clip 3) were 'Renewed' rather than new. Among the new options, there were concerning reviews regarding durability, such as the Altec Lansing model filling with water despite its waterproof rating and reports of the DOSS units failing after two months. Because I wanted a new, reliable, mid-range speaker and the selection felt limited by the influx of accessories, I decided not to make a purchase today.
